facts.fact: The health ministry's Stratégie Nationale E-Santé 2019-2023 carries project P121, strengthening and extension of the SNIS, running 2019 to 2023 and costed at USD 1.20 million of a USD 10 million action plan, to build a single national health information system taking in the ministry's vertical systems.

The strategy places the SNIS under the health ministry's Direction des Statistiques, which it names as the institution responsible for coordinating project P121; no date is given, so the strategy's 2019 publication year is used.

The P121 project sheet recommends recourse to partners' financing, and the plan's financing table assigns USD 1.00 million of the project's USD 1.20 million to technical and financial partners and nothing to the health ministry's own column; this is planned financing, not a recorded budget.

The strategy describes the SNIS as currently semi-electronic, reporting by electronic, semi-electronic and manual means, with DHIS2, online since September 2016, used for data entry in certain connected health facilities only; no date is given, so the 2019 publication year is used.

The strategy gives no count of facilities entering data in DHIS2; project P121 sets a baseline of 0 and a target of more than 50% for the share of ministry structures (health centres, hospitals, regional directorates, districts, central departments) connected to the SNIS and feeding it automatically.

Component b of project P121 in the 2019-2023 strategy plans a standard management application for autonomous health structures (hospitals), building towards a national hospital information system, and states that the electronic patient record will be developed within that component; it is a plan, with no system yet in place.

systems.platform: DHIS2 (www.dhisniger.ne, online since September 2016), alongside semi-electronic and manual reporting
systems.owner: Ministère de la Santé Publique, Direction des Statistiques
systems.tiers: whole country; DHIS2 used in certain connected health facilities

systems.country_label: Dossier Electronique du Patient (DEP) / Dossier Médical Personnel (DMP)

systems.system: système de gestion automatisé et standardisé des structures sanitaires non autonomes
systems.tiers: planned, non-autonomous health structures, adaptable for community health agents

systems.system: progiciels de gestion administrative, financière et médicale

note: Read as passages; this pass holds the project sheets and financing tables the earlier capture (n 19) lacked. The financing tables are garbled in extraction: the P121 figures are read from the rows that sum to its 1.20 total. The strategy also proposes open-source software options (openLMIS, DHIS2, openSRP, iHRIS, RapidPro, OpenClinic, openMRS, openELIS) without saying any but DHIS2 is deployed. The planned management application for non-autonomous structures covers consultations but is not said to hold the clinical record, so its class is empty.
